ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$, $AC$ is a chord of $\odot O$, $D$ is the midpoint of arc $BC$, draw $DE\perp AC$ at point $E$, and intersect the extension line of $AB$ at point $F$, connect $DA$. If $DA=DF=6\sqrt{3}$, calculate the area of the shaded region. (Keep the result in terms of $\pi$)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $DA=DF$, \\
it follows that $\angle F=\angle BAD$, \\
thus, we have $\angle CAD=\angle BAD$, \\
hence, $\angle F=\angle BAD=\angle CAD$, \\
since $\angle F+\angle BAD+\angle CAD=90^\circ$, \\
it implies $\angle F=\angle BAD=\angle CAD=30^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle BOD=2\angle BAD=60^\circ$, and $OF=2OD$, \\
given $DF=6\sqrt{3}$, \\
it leads to $(2OD)^{2}-OD^{2}=(6\sqrt{3})^{2}$, \\
solving yields: $OD=6$, \\
thus, $S_{\text{shaded}}=S_{\text{sector} BOD}+S_{\triangle AOD}=\frac{60\pi \times 6^{2}}{360}+\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times 6=6\pi +9\sqrt{3}=\boxed{6\pi +9\sqrt{3}}$.

Also chord AD has length 2r cosα. Use the given equality DA=DF: 2r cosα = r sin2α/cos2α, which simplifies to cos2α=sinα, giving α=30° in the relevant diagram range. Then DA=6√3=2r cos30° gives r=6. method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中右侧是几何图形，圆心为 O，AB 是水平直径，A 在圆的最右端，B 在左侧；AB 向左延长到 F。点 D 在圆的左上方，点 C 在圆的右上方，DE 与 AC 垂直并交于 E，且直线 DE 延长经过 F。阴影部分由扇形 BOD 和三角形 AOD 组成。左侧另有一张与几何题无关的实物图片，不参与计算。

再推理：按坐标三角法设 O=(0,0)，A=(r,0)，B=(-r,0)，F 在 x 轴左侧。令 α=∠BAD。因为 ∠BAD 截弧 BD，所以点 D 的极角为 π−2α；又因为 D 是弧 BC 的中点，所以点 C 的极角为 π−4α。由此 chord AC 的方向角为 π−2α，因此与 AC 垂直的 FD 的方向角为 π/2−2α。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$, $AC$ is a chord of $\odot O$, $D$ is the midpoint of arc $BC$, draw $DE\perp AC$ at point $E$, and let it intersect the extension of $AB$ at point $F$. Connect $DA$. If $DA=DF=6\sqrt{3}$, calculate the area of the shaded region. (Keep the result in terms of $\pi$)
raw_record.answer: Given $DA=DF$, it follows that $\angle F=\angle BAD$. Thus, we have $\angle CAD=\angle BAD$, hence $\angle F=\angle BAD=\angle CAD$. Since $\angle F+\angle BAD+\angle CAD=90^\circ$, it implies $\angle F=\angle BAD=\angle CAD=30^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle BOD=2\angle BAD=60^\circ$, and $OF=2OD$. Given $DF=6\sqrt{3}$, it leads to $(2OD)^{2}-OD^{2}=(6\sqrt{3})^{2}$, solving yields $OD=6$. Thus, $S_{\text{shaded}}=S_{\text{sector }BOD}+S_{\triangle AOD}=\frac{60\pi\times 6^{2}}{360}+\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times 6=6\pi+9\sqrt{3}=\boxed{6\pi+9\sqrt{3}}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: the left side of the attached image is a real object photo unrelated to the geometry problem; the right side is a geometric figure. In the right figure there is circle O, AB is a horizontal diameter, O is on AB, A is at the right end of the circle, and B is on the left side of the circle; D is above the circle and slightly to the left, and C is at the upper right of the circle; F is on the left extension of AB; line F-D-E intersects chord AC at E, and the problem gives DE⊥AC. The shaded part in the right geometric figure is composed of sector BOD and triangle AOD.

Then reason: because DA=DF, triangle ADF is an isosceles triangle, so ∠DFA=∠FAD. Also F, B, and A are collinear, so ∠FAD=∠BAD, therefore ∠DFA=∠BAD. D is the midpoint of arc BC, so arc BD=arc DC, and the corresponding inscribed angles are equal, that is, ∠BAD=∠CAD. Since DE⊥AC, and F, D, E are collinear, DF⊥AC. According to the arrangement of angles in the figure, ∠DFA+∠BAD+∠CAD=90°. The three angles are equal, so each angle is 30°. Therefore ∠BOD=2∠BAD=60°. In triangle ODF, OF and OB are on the same straight line, so ∠DOF=60°, and ∠DFO=30°, this is a 30°-60°-90° triangle. DF corresponds to the side opposite the 60° angle, and OD corresponds to the side opposite the 30° angle, so DF=√3·OD. Given DF=6√3, obtain OD=6. Thus the radius r=6. Shaded area=area of sector BOD+area of triangle AOD. The area of sector BOD is (60/360)π·6²=6π. Because AB is a diameter, ∠AOB=180°, so ∠AOD=180°-60°=120°, and the area of triangle AOD is (1/2)·6·6·sin120°=9√3. The total area is 6π+9√3.
